thread:
Priya Patel: Quick check — the in-app reference pane copy diverges from docs.redwood.com. Specifically: the pane uses 'Guide' in headers but docs site uses 'Reference'. This confuses support and new users. Can we pick one term and add a crosslink? Alex Kim: Yeah noticed that. My take: 'Reference' is more precise for API-style content. 'Guide' implies walk-throughs. :thumbsup: Sam Ortega: Agree on 'Reference'. UX question: do we change labels only, or also add a small 'Open on docs site' link at the top-right of the pane? Priya Patel: Prefer both — sync wording and add link. Link should open in new tab and preserve section anchor. Accessibility note: make link text 'Open reference in docs (new tab)'. Tilly Chen: Small accessibility nit — the reference pane heading doesn't have an aria-level set when collapsed. Screen readers read it as generic div. We should ensure heading roles: `
Reference
` or use `h2`. Alex Kim: For consistency with docs anchors, let's use slug mapping. Example mapping file (proposal): ``` { "pane_header": "reference", "section_slugs": { "api_keys": "api-keys", "batching": "batching-and-cache" } } ``` Sam Ortega: That works. Also UX: add a tiny chain icon before external link and aria-label='Open in docs (new tab)'. Priya Patel: Copy tweak: current pane CTA says 'Read more' — change to 'Open reference in docs' so users know it's external. Tilly Chen: Color contrast check — link uses 3.4:1 on our current palette, needs to be 4.5:1 for small text. Suggest using brand-600 or underline+focus ring. Alex Kim: I can implement label swaps and link; Tilly, can you propose exact colors inline? Tilly Chen: I'll post hex suggestions in UX PR. Also adding keyboard shortcut hint would be great — like `?` opens help, maybe `Shift+/` for reference quick jump. Sam Ortega: Minor: breadcrumbs in pane show 'Docs > Guide' — change to 'Docs > Reference'. docs-bot: new comment on PR #422: 'Heading role updated, external link aria-label added, copy replaced, contrast remedied to #0057b8' :white_check_mark: Priya Patel: Awesome. Next: crosslink anchor behavior — if the user is deep in the pane and clicks 'Open in docs', should we carry the same scroll position? Prefer yes. Alex Kim: I'll add scroll-to-anchor support in the link: `https://docs.redwood.com/reference#batching-and-cache`. Sam Ortega: One last thing — add a microcopy tooltip explaining why some examples are truncated in-pane: 'Examples in the pane are shortened for readability; view full examples on docs.' Priya Patel: Love that. I'll update the spec and add copy. Thanks everyone :sparkles: Tilly Chen: :eyes: follow-up in the PR with accessibility checklist.
